about: The Workbench icons of the Gigalomania drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 64x64 icon (gigalomania64.png, GPL like the game). Gigalomania-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Gigalomania.info beside the drawer; gigalomania.info is the program's. ReadMe.info is also copied for readme.html, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of gfx, sound, music, islands and User.
